symbols.name: transform length
symbols.meaning: The number of ring elements along one axis, a power of two dividing 2r.
symbols.quote: Let $t$ be the transform length, the number of ring elements along one axis, a power of two dividing $2r$.

symbols.name: two-adic exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of 2 in j when j is written as 2^e times an odd number.
symbols.quote: If $t\nmid j$, write $j$ as $2^e$ times an odd number, with $0\le e<\log_2 t$.

relations.quote: A synthetic polynomial transform is a transform over the [Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1](ring-y.md) whose roots of unity are powers of $y$, so every twiddle multiplication (multiplication by a root of unity) is a signed shift of a coefficient list.

relations.quote: The synthetic transforms are given by the formulas of the [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md), with $\omega_t$ in place of the complex root of unity:
As in the complex case, $F_t^-$ is computed by [Butterflies and the fast transform](butterfly.md) in $\log_2 t$ layers, each twiddle multiplication being a signed shift.
